analysis: The supplied changes are documentation-only. They cover docs/developer/build.md, shown as head text at lines 444-1260, and docs/developer/test.md, which has a metadata-only unit plus a patch adding a landing story-gesture test description at about line 3518. No runtime, authorization, attestation, encryption, billing or availability code changed. The build.md text describes the build, test and release procedures, including the App Attest qualification guidance and the native worker's default-off candidate status. It does not change documented trust policy. It reaffirms that tests do not qualify signed artifacts, that Apple/physical gates stay separate, and that the canonical verifier and backend documentation live in the sibling darkbloom-platform repository. The test.md addition describes DOM tests only (`node --test tests/story-gestures.test.mjs`), and states that they do not replace browser checks. The cache-related T-041 definition was supplied but is unaffected by these edits. The build.md excerpt contains no instructions that conflict with the threat model. Findings: none. Coverage limit: build.md base text and the diff were not supplied, so I could not isolate exactly which lines changed. I examined only the head text excerpts and the test.md patch. I found no changed claims that weaken T-052..T-058 or TB-011.
